cards.audioText: Your call sign is Air France 754, a flight from Paris to Guangzhou, you are leveling at 10100m, near DAPRO, squawk 3645, you are now at Wuhan control zone. Call Wuhan Control 128.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航754，从巴黎飞往广州，你的高度是10100米，接近DAPRO，应答机3645，你现在在武汉管制区域，呼叫武汉区调128.75。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR754, 10100m, near DAPRO, squawk 3645.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航754,10100米，接近DAPRO，应答机3645。

cards.audioText: AFR754, radar contact, continue climbing to 10300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航754，雷达识别，继续爬升到10300米。

cards.audioText: During climbing, you encountered CB and request 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.audioTextZh: 在爬升过程中，你遇到了积雨云，并请求西偏航20海里
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR754, request 20 miles deviation to the west due CB.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航754，由于积雨云，请求西偏航20海里。

cards.audioText:
AFR754, 20 miles deviate west is approved.
[During cruise, you find that the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航754，同意西偏航20海里。
[在巡航过程中，你发现导航性能降级，向管制员报告，请他们核实你的飞行轨迹]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR754, our navigation performance down-graded, request verify our flight track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航754，我们的导航性能降级，请求核实我们的飞行轨迹。

cards.audioText: AFR754, you are still on track.
Your weather radar failed, make an emergency call to Wuhan Control and request divert to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达失效了，向武汉区调做紧急呼叫，并请求改航到武汉机场
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Wuhan Control, AFR754, our weather radar failed, request divert to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan，武汉区调，法航754，我们的气象雷达失效了，请求改航到武汉机场。

cards.audioText: AFR754, roger Panpan, turn left to WHA, descend to 5100m. Contact Wuhan Approach on 119.65.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航754，收到Pan，左转飞至WHA，下降到5100米，联系武汉进近119.65。
cards.referenceText: Turn left to WHA, descend to 5100m, contact 119.65, AFR754.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转飞至WHA，下降到5100米，联系119.65，法航754。

cards.audioText: Contact Wuhan Approach, tell them your situation and ask for the current weather information at Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 联系武汉进近，告诉他们你的清况，并询问当前武汉机场的天气信息
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR754, we are diverting to Wuhan airport due weather radar failure, confirm the weather in Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航754，由于气象雷达失效，我们正改航至武汉机场，证实武汉机场的天气。

cards.audioText: During descent, you find the flaps are jammed at the fully retracted position, request to terminate approach and hold at WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，你发现襟翼完全卡阻在收上的位置，请求终止进近，在WHA等待，排除故障
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR754, our flaps jammed, request to terminate approach and hold at WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航754，我们的襟翼卡阻，请求终止进近，在WHA等待，排除故障。

cards.audioText: AFR754, track direct to WHA and climb to 900m, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航754，直飞WHA，爬升到900米，按公布（程序）等待。
cards.referenceText: Direct to WHA, climb to 900m, hold as published, AFR754.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞WHA，爬升到900米，按公布（程序）等待。

cards.audioText: After trouble shooting, you still cannot fix the problem, tell Wuhan Approach you are making high speed approach due flaps jam.
cards.audioTextZh: 经过故障排除，你依旧无法解决问题，告知武汉进近，由于襟翼卡阻，你将进行大速度进近
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR754, request high speed approach due flaps jam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航754，由于襟翼卡阻，请求大速度进近。

cards.audioText: Now contact Wuhan Tower and ask for braking action status.
cards.audioTextZh: [联系武汉塔台，并询问跑道刹车效应]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR754, confirm braking action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航754，证实刹车效应。

cards.audioText: After landing, your aircraft skidded off the runway and your nose wheel is bogged, notify your situation and ask for emergency assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆后，你的飞机偏出跑道，你的前轮陷进泥里了，告知你的情况并请求紧急救援。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR754, our aircraft skidded off the runway and the nose wheel is bogged, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航754，我们的飞机偏出跑道，前轮陷进泥里了，请求紧急救援。
